verdict.rationale: Terraform has no llms.txt or docs.md agent-readable file (confirmed 404 by probes), so the specific artifact requested by the story is absent. However, HashiCorp does provide an official MCP server that gives AI models real-time access to Terraform provider documentation, modules, and policies, which is an agent-oriented documentation access mechanism, giving partial credit. Missing for 10: an actual llms.txt/docs.md file, and any evidence the MCP server is a drop-in substitute for llms.txt-style doc consumption.
